description: A React component named JsonModal that displays JSON content in a modal dialog with options to view as formatted or raw, copy, download, and view content with markdown rendering support.

methods.name: JsonModal
methods.description: Main React component that renders a modal dialog to display JSON content with various viewing options.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Copies the current content (formatted or raw) to the clipboard.

methods.name: handleDownload
methods.description: Downloads the current content as a text file, with filename based on the provided path.

methods.name: renderContent
methods.description: Renders the JSON content according to the selected view mode, including markdown parsing if applicable.
